[SKU-V11 / VENDOR / EXTENSIV]

Extensiv 3PL Warehouse Manager cost

Extensiv (formerly 3PL Central, rebranded 2022) publishes no rate card for 3PL Warehouse Manager. As of 22 September 2026 extensiv.com/pricing returns a hard 404 with no redirect, no pricing or plans page appears in the sitemap, and the navigation and footer carry no pricing link. The only plan detail Extensiv publishes is on its brand-side plan pages, which name four plans (Core, In-house, Network and 360) with feature bullets behind a Request a Demo button and no figures. So: quote-only, and we do not invent a number.

[SKU-A / PRICING POSTURE]

Quote-only

Quote-only SaaS. Extensiv publishes no rate card for 3PL Warehouse Manager; the only plan detail it publishes is on its brand-side plan pages, which name four plans (Core, In-house, Network and 360) behind Request a Demo with no figures[s-12][s-48].

[SKU-B / COST DRIVERS]

What changes the quote

  • Number of clients (3PL) and warehouses.
  • Which products are licensed: 3PL WMS, Network Management, Billing Manager, Smartscan, Small Parcel Suite, Reporting and Analytics.
  • Marketplace and EDI integrations through Integration Manager.
  • Billing-engine depth needed: per-client storage, per-pallet, per-order, accessorials.
[SKU-C / RECENT CHANGES]

2025-26 product and pricing

Extensiv has taken its pricing page down. extensiv.com/pricing returns a hard 404 with no redirect, no pricing or plans URL appears in the sitemap, and there is no pricing link in the site navigation or footer (all checked 22 Sep 2026). The nearest published plan detail is the brand-side plan pages, which list four plans (Core, In-house, Network, 360) with feature and warehouse-count bullets behind a Request a Demo button and no dollar figures. We previously described Starter, Standard, Premium and Enterprise tiers for this product; Extensiv publishes those names nowhere we can cite, so the record is now quote-only with no published pricing. 3PL Central rebranded to Extensiv in 2022. The product menu now reads 3PL WMS, Network Management, Billing Manager, Smartscan, Small Parcel Suite, Reporting and Analytics, and Extensiv AI; Integration Manager (formerly CartRover) sits under Ecosystem. There is no longer a standalone Order Manager product page.

[SKU-D / FIT]

When this vendor is the answer

  • SMB 3PL with up to ~50 clients.
  • E-commerce-led fulfilment 3PL needing native marketplace integrations.
  • Existing 3PL Central customer (now Extensiv) staying on platform.
[SKU-E / FAQ]

Buyer questions

Does Extensiv publish any pricing at all?

No. extensiv.com/pricing returned 404 when we checked it on 22 September 2026, with no redirect and no replacement anywhere on the site: not in the sitemap, not in the navigation, not in the footer. The four brand plan pages (Core, In-house, Network, 360) list plan names and feature bullets but no dollar figures, and each ends in Request a Demo. Anyone quoting an Extensiv list price is quoting something Extensiv does not publish.

What changed in the 3PL Central rebrand?

The 2022 rebrand to Extensiv consolidated the acquired products under one brand. As of September 2026 the published product menu reads 3PL WMS, Network Management, Billing Manager, Smartscan, Small Parcel Suite, Reporting and Analytics, and Extensiv AI, with Integration Manager (formerly CartRover) listed under Ecosystem. There is no longer a standalone Order Manager product page.

Extensiv vs ShipHero?

See /vs/extensiv-vs-shiphero. Extensiv leads on multi-client 3PL billing depth; ShipHero leads on single-brand DTC and the optional fulfilment network. Neither publishes a rate card now.
